fill: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.
bold: Source-derived emphasis includes Control A; Control B; COMMIT SET; Incompatible demands. Bold control and shared-resource names contrast with their demands; the conflict explanation is italic, not another control.
routing: 2 simple diagonal process links replaced by aligned ports or short orthogonal rails; existing feedback/dashed semantics retained.
shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
visual_review: Both native check marks retained; shared resource and dashed conflict distinct.
routing_exceptions: Outer return paths retained where needed to show feedback without crossing forward flow.
